aws.cb.rds.postgres_log_exports.description: Flags an RDS DB instance when a PostgreSQL RDS instance does not export both `postgresql` and `upgrade` logs to CloudWatch. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_log_exports.pass_when: PASS when both `postgresql` and `upgrade` are in EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_log_exports.fail_when: FAIL when a PostgreSQL RDS instance does not export both `postgresql` and `upgrade` logs to CloudWatch.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_log_exports.not_applicable_when: When the RDS engine is not PostgreSQL.

aws.cb.rds.security_group_critical_event.description: Flags a regional RDS event subscription inventory when a region with RDS instances has no enabled db-security-group subscription covering configuration change and failure categories. It can expose database activity or connections and make unauthorized changes harder to detect.
aws.cb.rds.security_group_critical_event.pass_when: PASS when an enabled matching db-security-group subscription exists.
aws.cb.rds.security_group_critical_event.fail_when: FAIL when a region with RDS instances has no enabled db-security-group subscription covering configuration change and failure categories.
aws.cb.rds.security_group_critical_event.not_applicable_when: When no RDS instance is collected in the region.

aws.cb.rds.sqlserver_error_log_export.description: Checks whether an RDS instance whose Engine begins with `sqlserver` exports the `error` log to CloudWatch. Missing error logs can hide database failures and security events.
aws.cb.rds.sqlserver_error_log_export.fail_when: FAIL when an RDS engine beginning with `sqlserver` does not export the `error` log.
aws.cb.rds.sqlserver_error_log_export.not_applicable_when: When Engine does not begin with `sqlserver`.

aws.cb.rds.sqlserver_force_ssl_parameter.description: Checks the `rds.force_ssl` parameter on every RDS instance whose Engine begins with `sqlserver`. A missing value or any value other than the string `1` fails.
aws.cb.rds.sqlserver_force_ssl_parameter.fail_when: FAIL when `ParameterGroupValues.rds.force_ssl` is absent or differs from the string `1`.
aws.cb.rds.sqlserver_force_ssl_parameter.not_applicable_when: When Engine does not begin with `sqlserver`.

aws.cb.redshift.allow_version_upgrade.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `AllowVersionUpgrade` differs from true. Disabled upgrades can leave the warehouse on an engine version missing security fixes.

aws.cb.redshift.audit_logging.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `LoggingStatus.LoggingEnabled` is false. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.

aws.cb.redshift.cmk_encryption.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when the cluster is unencrypted or its resolved KMS key is not customer managed. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.redshift.cmk_encryption.pass_when: PASS when the cluster is encrypted with a customer managed key.
aws.cb.redshift.cmk_encryption.fail_when: FAIL when the cluster is unencrypted or its resolved KMS key is not customer managed.

aws.cb.redshift.encrypted.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `Encrypted` differs from true. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.

aws.cb.redshift.encrypted_and_logging.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when cluster encryption is off or its `LoggingStatus.LoggingEnabled` is false. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.redshift.encrypted_and_logging.pass_when: PASS when encryption is on and `LoggingStatus.LoggingEnabled` is true.
aws.cb.redshift.encrypted_and_logging.fail_when: FAIL when cluster encryption is off or its `LoggingStatus.LoggingEnabled` is false.

aws.cb.redshift.enhanced_vpc_routing.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `EnhancedVpcRouting` differs from true. Data traffic can bypass the intended VPC routing controls during COPY and UNLOAD operations.

aws.cb.redshift.has_snapshot.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when no snapshot in the complete `redshift_snapshot` inventory matches `ClusterIdentifier`. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.cb.redshift.has_snapshot.pass_when: PASS when at least one Redshift snapshot matches the cluster identifier.
aws.cb.redshift.has_snapshot.fail_when: FAIL when no snapshot in the complete `redshift_snapshot` inventory matches `ClusterIdentifier`.

aws.cb.redshift.internet_exposed.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when a cluster has an endpoint address, is publicly accessible, has a public subnet, and an attached security group admits all-address TCP ingress. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.cb.redshift.internet_exposed.pass_when: PASS when at least one of those exposure conditions is absent.
aws.cb.redshift.internet_exposed.fail_when: FAIL when a cluster has an endpoint address, is publicly accessible, has a public subnet, and an attached security group admits all-address TCP ingress.

aws.cb.redshift.kms_key_declared.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when the cluster is unencrypted or its KmsKeyId is empty or absent. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.redshift.kms_key_declared.pass_when: PASS when the cluster is encrypted and declares a KMS key ID.
aws.cb.redshift.kms_key_declared.fail_when: FAIL when the cluster is unencrypted or its KmsKeyId is empty or absent.

aws.cb.redshift.maintenance_settings.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `AllowVersionUpgrade` is false or `AutomatedSnapshotRetentionPeriod` is below 7. It can expose warehouse data or make the analytics service less resilient to failure.
aws.cb.redshift.maintenance_settings.pass_when: PASS when version upgrades are allowed and snapshots are retained at least 7 days.
aws.cb.redshift.maintenance_settings.fail_when: FAIL when `AllowVersionUpgrade` is false or `AutomatedSnapshotRetentionPeriod` is below 7.

aws.cb.redshift.multi_az.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `MultiAZ` differs from `Enabled`. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.

aws.cb.redshift.non_default_database_nam.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `DBName` equals `dev`. It can expose warehouse data or make the analytics service less resilient to failure.

aws.cb.redshift.non_default_master_usern.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `MasterUsername` equals `awsuser`. It can expose warehouse data or make the analytics service less resilient to failure.

aws.cb.redshift.not_publicly_accessible.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `PubliclyAccessible` differs from false. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.

aws.cb.redshift.require_ssl.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when the cluster parameter `require_ssl` is absent or its string value is not case-insensitive `true`. It leaves transport or authentication material exposed to weaker cryptographic protection.
aws.cb.redshift.require_ssl.pass_when: PASS when the require_ssl parameter string equals true ignoring case.
aws.cb.redshift.require_ssl.fail_when: FAIL when the cluster parameter `require_ssl` is absent or its string value is not case-insensitive `true`.

aws.cb.redshift.security_group_port_rest.description: Checks attached Redshift security group ingress for a world CIDR and a port range covering Endpoint.Port (default 5439). The evaluator counts any protocol with such a range, or protocol `-1` without FromPort.
aws.cb.redshift.security_group_port_rest.pass_when: PASS when no attached security group has 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 ingress with a port range covering the cluster port, or protocol `-1` without FromPort.
aws.cb.redshift.security_group_port_rest.fail_when: FAIL when an attached security group has 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 ingress with a port range covering Endpoint.Port (default 5439), regardless of protocol, or protocol `-1` without FromPort.

aws.cb.redshift.snapshot_retention_7_day.description: Flags a Redshift cluster when `AutomatedSnapshotRetentionPeriod` is less than 7 days. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.cb.redshift.snapshot_retention_7_day.pass_when: PASS when automated snapshot retention is at least 7 days.
aws.cb.redshift.snapshot_retention_7_day.fail_when: FAIL when `AutomatedSnapshotRetentionPeriod` is less than 7 days.

aws.cb.redshiftserverless.connection_use.description: Flags a Redshift Serverless namespace when `logExports` lacks either `connectionlog` or `userlog`. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.redshiftserverless.connection_use.pass_when: PASS when both required log export names are present.

aws.cb.redshiftserverless.enhanced_vpc_r.description: Flags a Redshift Serverless workgroup when `enhancedVpcRouting` differs from true. It can expose warehouse data or make the analytics service less resilient to failure.

aws.cb.redshiftserverless.non_default_ad.description: Flags a Redshift Serverless namespace when `adminUsername` equals `admin`. It can expose warehouse data or make the analytics service less resilient to failure.

aws.cb.redshiftserverless.non_default_da.description: Flags a Redshift Serverless namespace when `dbName` equals `dev`. It can expose warehouse data or make the analytics service less resilient to failure.

aws.cb.redshiftserverless.not_publicly_a.description: Flags a Redshift Serverless workgroup when `publiclyAccessible` differs from false. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.

aws.cb.redshiftserverless.require_ssl.description: Flags a Redshift Serverless workgroup when no `configParameters` element has `parameterKey=require_ssl` and `parameterValue=true`. It leaves transport or authentication material exposed to weaker cryptographic protection.
aws.cb.redshiftserverless.require_ssl.pass_when: PASS when a require_ssl parameter has the exact value true.
aws.cb.redshiftserverless.require_ssl.fail_when: FAIL when no `configParameters` element has `parameterKey=require_ssl` and `parameterValue=true`.

aws.cb.resourceexplorer2.index_exists.description: Checks the account Resource Explorer 2 index list returned in each regional scope. An empty collected list fails.
aws.cb.resourceexplorer2.index_exists.pass_when: PASS when the collected account index list contains at least one index.
aws.cb.resourceexplorer2.index_exists.fail_when: FAIL when the collected account index list is empty.

aws.cb.rolesanywhere.trust_anchor_pqc.description: Flags a rolesanywhere trust anchor when an AWS ACM PCA trust anchor resolves to a CA that is inactive or whose key algorithm is not ML_DSA_44, ML_DSA_65, or ML_DSA_87. It leaves transport or authentication material exposed to weaker cryptographic protection.
aws.cb.rolesanywhere.trust_anchor_pqc.pass_when: PASS when the referenced CA is active and uses an accepted ML-DSA key algorithm.
aws.cb.rolesanywhere.trust_anchor_pqc.fail_when: FAIL when an AWS ACM PCA trust anchor resolves to a CA that is inactive or whose key algorithm is not ML_DSA_44, ML_DSA_65, or ML_DSA_87.

aws.cb.route53.domain_auto_renew.description: Flags a Route 53 domain when `Detail.AutoRenew` differs from true. An unlocked or expiring domain can be transferred or lapse, interrupting DNS and enabling takeover.

aws.cb.route53.domain_expires_after_30_d.description: Flags a Route 53 domain when the domain expiration date is fewer than 30 calendar days from the snapshot clock. An unlocked or expiring domain can be transferred or lapse, interrupting DNS and enabling takeover.
aws.cb.route53.domain_expires_after_30_d.pass_when: PASS when at least 30 calendar days remain.
aws.cb.route53.domain_expires_after_30_d.fail_when: FAIL when the domain expiration date is fewer than 30 calendar days from the snapshot clock.

aws.cb.route53.domain_expires_after_7_da.description: Flags a Route 53 domain when the domain expiration date is fewer than 7 calendar days from the snapshot clock. An unlocked or expiring domain can be transferred or lapse, interrupting DNS and enabling takeover.
aws.cb.route53.domain_expires_after_7_da.pass_when: PASS when at least 7 calendar days remain.
aws.cb.route53.domain_expires_after_7_da.fail_when: FAIL when the domain expiration date is fewer than 7 calendar days from the snapshot clock.

aws.cb.route53.domain_not_expired.description: Flags a Route 53 domain when the domain expiration date is more than one minute in the past. An unlocked or expiring domain can be transferred or lapse, interrupting DNS and enabling takeover.
aws.cb.route53.domain_not_expired.pass_when: PASS when the expiration date is not more than one minute in the past.
aws.cb.route53.domain_not_expired.fail_when: FAIL when the domain expiration date is more than one minute in the past.

aws.cb.route53.domain_privacy_protection.description: Flags a Route 53 domain when `Detail.AdminPrivacy` differs from true. Administrative contact details may be exposed in domain registration records.

aws.cb.route53.domain_transfer_lock.description: Flags a Route 53 domain when `Detail.StatusList` lacks `clientTransferProhibited`. An unlocked or expiring domain can be transferred or lapse, interrupting DNS and enabling takeover.
aws.cb.route53.domain_transfer_lock.pass_when: PASS when the transfer-prohibition status is present.

aws.cb.route53.public_zone_query_logging.description: Flags a Route 53 hosted zone when a public hosted zone has no QueryLoggingConfig with a CloudWatch Logs group ARN. Unlogged DNS queries hinder investigation of domain abuse or suspicious lookups.
aws.cb.route53.public_zone_query_logging.pass_when: PASS when at least one query logging destination group ARN is present.
aws.cb.route53.public_zone_query_logging.fail_when: FAIL when a public hosted zone has no QueryLoggingConfig with a CloudWatch Logs group ARN.
aws.cb.route53.public_zone_query_logging.not_applicable_when: When the hosted zone is private.

aws.cb.sagemaker.clarify_job_exists.description: Checks a region with SageMaker models for a processing job whose AppSpecification.ImageUri contains `sagemaker-clarify-processing`.
aws.cb.sagemaker.clarify_job_exists.pass_when: PASS when at least one processing job image URI contains `sagemaker-clarify-processing`.
aws.cb.sagemaker.clarify_job_exists.fail_when: FAIL when a region with SageMaker models has no processing job image URI containing `sagemaker-clarify-processing`.
aws.cb.sagemaker.clarify_job_exists.not_applicable_when: When the region has no SageMaker models.

aws.cb.sagemaker.domain_sso.description: Checks a SageMaker domain for AuthMode SSO and either a SingleSignOnManagedApplicationInstanceId or a SingleSignOnApplicationArn. Missing either requirement fails.
aws.cb.sagemaker.domain_sso.pass_when: PASS when AuthMode is SSO and either SingleSignOnManagedApplicationInstanceId or SingleSignOnApplicationArn is present.
aws.cb.sagemaker.domain_sso.fail_when: FAIL when AuthMode is not SSO or both SSO application identifiers are absent.

aws.cb.sagemaker.endpoint_config_kms.description: Flags a SageMaker endpoint configuration when `KmsKeyId` is absent. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.

aws.cb.sagemaker.endpoint_variants_more_.description: Flags a SageMaker endpoint configuration when any production variant has `InitialInstanceCount` of one or less. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.
aws.cb.sagemaker.endpoint_variants_more_.pass_when: PASS when each integer production variant count is greater than one.
aws.cb.sagemaker.endpoint_variants_more_.fail_when: FAIL when any production variant has `InitialInstanceCount` of one or less.

aws.cb.sagemaker.endpoint_variants_not_e.description: Flags a SageMaker endpoint configuration when any production variant has `InitialInstanceCount` exactly one. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.
aws.cb.sagemaker.endpoint_variants_not_e.pass_when: PASS when no production variant has an integer instance count of exactly one.
aws.cb.sagemaker.endpoint_variants_not_e.fail_when: FAIL when any production variant has `InitialInstanceCount` exactly one.

aws.cb.sagemaker.model_network_isolation.description: Flags a SageMaker model when `EnableNetworkIsolation` differs from true. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.

aws.cb.sagemaker.model_registry_approved.description: Checks a region with SageMaker models for a model package group whose ApprovedPackages count exceeds zero.
aws.cb.sagemaker.model_registry_approved.pass_when: PASS when at least one model package group has ApprovedPackages greater than zero.
aws.cb.sagemaker.model_registry_approved.fail_when: FAIL when no model package group has ApprovedPackages greater than zero in a region with SageMaker models.
aws.cb.sagemaker.model_registry_approved.not_applicable_when: When the region has no SageMaker models.

aws.cb.sagemaker.model_vpc_config.description: Flags a SageMaker model when the model has no `VpcConfig` object. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.
aws.cb.sagemaker.model_vpc_config.pass_when: PASS when a VpcConfig object is present.
aws.cb.sagemaker.model_vpc_config.fail_when: FAIL when the model has no `VpcConfig` object.

aws.cb.sagemaker.model_vpc_subnets.description: Flags a SageMaker model when a model has no subnet IDs in `VpcConfig.Subnets`. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.
aws.cb.sagemaker.model_vpc_subnets.pass_when: PASS when the model lists at least one VPC subnet.
aws.cb.sagemaker.model_vpc_subnets.fail_when: FAIL when a model has no subnet IDs in `VpcConfig.Subnets`.

aws.cb.sagemaker.monitoring_schedule_act.description: Checks a region with SageMaker models for a monitoring schedule whose MonitoringScheduleStatus is exactly `Scheduled`.
aws.cb.sagemaker.monitoring_schedule_act.pass_when: PASS when at least one monitoring schedule has MonitoringScheduleStatus `Scheduled`.
aws.cb.sagemaker.monitoring_schedule_act.fail_when: FAIL when no monitoring schedule has MonitoringScheduleStatus `Scheduled` in a region with SageMaker models.
aws.cb.sagemaker.monitoring_schedule_act.not_applicable_when: When the region has no SageMaker models.

aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_cmk.description: Flags a SageMaker notebook instance when a notebook has no KMS key or its referenced key is not customer managed. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the referenced notebook KMS key is customer managed.
aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when a notebook has no KMS key or its referenced key is not customer managed.

aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_in_vpc.description: Flags a SageMaker notebook instance when `SubnetId` is absent. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.

aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_kms_key.description: Flags a SageMaker notebook instance when a notebook has no `KmsKeyId`. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_kms_key.pass_when: PASS when the notebook declares a KMS key ID.
aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_kms_key.fail_when: FAIL when a notebook has no `KmsKeyId`.

aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_no_direct_inte.description: Flags a SageMaker notebook instance when `DirectInternetAccess` differs from `Disabled`. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.

aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_root_access_di.description: Flags a SageMaker notebook instance when `RootAccess` differs from `Disabled`. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.

aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_supported_plat.description: Checks a SageMaker notebook PlatformIdentifier against documented launch and support-end dates using the captured observation date.
aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_supported_plat.pass_when: A reviewed supported platform, including notebook-al2023-v1 during the reviewed window, is observed.
aws.cb.sagemaker.notebook_supported_plat.fail_when: A reviewed platform has reached its documented support end by the captured date.

aws.cb.sagemaker.training_intercontainer.description: Flags a SageMaker training job when `EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption` differs from true. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.

aws.cb.sagemaker.training_network_isolat.description: Flags a SageMaker training job when `EnableNetworkIsolation` differs from true. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.

aws.cb.sagemaker.training_output_kms.description: Flags a SageMaker training job when `OutputDataConfig.KmsKeyId` is empty or missing. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_output_kms.pass_when: PASS when an output data KMS key ID is configured.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_output_kms.fail_when: FAIL when `OutputDataConfig.KmsKeyId` is empty or missing.

aws.cb.sagemaker.training_volume_kms.description: Flags a SageMaker training job when `ResourceConfig.VolumeKmsKeyId` is empty or missing. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_volume_kms.pass_when: PASS when a training volume KMS key ID is configured.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_volume_kms.fail_when: FAIL when `ResourceConfig.VolumeKmsKeyId` is empty or missing.

aws.cb.sagemaker.training_vpc_config.description: Flags a SageMaker training job when a training job lacks `VpcConfig` altogether. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_vpc_config.pass_when: PASS when the training job has a VPC configuration.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_vpc_config.fail_when: FAIL when a training job lacks `VpcConfig` altogether.

aws.cb.sagemaker.training_vpc_subnets.description: Flags a SageMaker training job when a training job has no subnet IDs in `VpcConfig.Subnets`. It can expose model data, training output, or endpoint availability to unauthorized or unreliable operation.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_vpc_subnets.pass_when: PASS when the training job names at least one VPC subnet.
aws.cb.sagemaker.training_vpc_subnets.fail_when: FAIL when a training job has no subnet IDs in `VpcConfig.Subnets`.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.accessed_within_90.description: Flags a secret when the secret has no LastAccessedDate or its calendar-day age exceeds 90. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.accessed_within_90.pass_when: PASS when a recorded access is within 90 calendar days.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.accessed_within_90.fail_when: FAIL when the secret has no LastAccessedDate or its calendar-day age exceeds 90.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.accessed_within_90.description: Flags a secret when the secret has no LastAccessedDate or its exact elapsed time exceeds 90 days. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.accessed_within_90.pass_when: PASS when a recorded access is within an exact 90-day interval.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.accessed_within_90.fail_when: FAIL when the secret has no LastAccessedDate or its exact elapsed time exceeds 90 days.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.changed_within_365.description: Flags a secret when `LastChangedDate` is absent or more than 365 calendar days old. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.changed_within_365.pass_when: PASS when the secret was changed within 365 calendar days.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.changed_within_365.fail_when: FAIL when `LastChangedDate` is absent or more than 365 calendar days old.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.changed_within_90_.description: Flags a secret when `LastChangedDate` is absent or more than 90 calendar days old. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.changed_within_90_.pass_when: PASS when the secret was changed within 90 calendar days.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.changed_within_90_.fail_when: FAIL when `LastChangedDate` is absent or more than 90 calendar days old.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.cmk_encryption.description: Flags a secret when the secret has no KMS key, uses `alias/aws/secretsmanager`, or the resolved key is not customer managed. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.cmk_encryption.pass_when: PASS when the secret uses a customer managed KMS key.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.cmk_encryption.fail_when: FAIL when the secret has no KMS key, uses `alias/aws/secretsmanager`, or the resolved key is not customer managed.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_not_public.description: Flags a secret when the parsed secret resource policy grants access to a public principal under the account-aware policy test. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_not_public.pass_when: PASS when the secret policy is absent or contains no public grant.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when the parsed secret resource policy grants access to a public principal under the account-aware policy test.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_not_public.not_applicable_when: When the resource policy is absent.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_prohibit_pu.description: Flags a secret when the secret resource policy contains a Turbot-style public Allow statement. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_prohibit_pu.pass_when: PASS when no secret policy statement matches that public access test.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_prohibit_pu.fail_when: FAIL when the secret resource policy contains a Turbot-style public Allow statement.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.policy_prohibit_pu.not_applicable_when: When the resource policy is absent.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotated_as_schedul.description: Flags a secret when the primary-region secret lacks rotation rules or its last rotation or creation exceeds `AutomaticallyAfterDays`. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotated_as_schedul.pass_when: PASS when the elapsed calendar days do not exceed the rotation schedule.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotated_as_schedul.fail_when: FAIL when the primary-region secret lacks rotation rules or its last rotation or creation exceeds `AutomaticallyAfterDays`.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotated_as_schedul.not_applicable_when: When this is a replica secret whose primary region is elsewhere.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotated_within_90_.description: Flags a secret when the secret has no recorded rotation or its last rotation was more than 90 whole days ago. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotated_within_90_.pass_when: PASS when a recorded rotation is at most 90 whole days old.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotated_within_90_.fail_when: FAIL when the secret has no recorded rotation or its last rotation was more than 90 whole days ago.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotation_lambda.description: Flags a secret when the secret lacks rotation rules or a RotationLambdaARN. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotation_lambda.pass_when: PASS when rotation rules and a Lambda ARN are both present.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotation_lambda.fail_when: FAIL when the secret lacks rotation rules or a RotationLambdaARN.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotation_rules_pre.description: Flags a secret when the secret has no RotationRules object. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotation_rules_pre.pass_when: PASS when a RotationRules object is present.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.rotation_rules_pre.fail_when: FAIL when the secret has no RotationRules object.

aws.cb.secretsmanager.used_after_creatio.description: Flags a secret when the secret was never accessed or first access is less than one calendar day after creation. It increases the chance that stale or exposed credentials remain usable.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.used_after_creatio.pass_when: PASS when recorded access is at least one calendar day after creation.
aws.cb.secretsmanager.used_after_creatio.fail_when: FAIL when the secret was never accessed or first access is less than one calendar day after creation.

aws.cb.servicecatalog.no_account_shares.description: Flags a servicecatalog portfolio when the portfolio has any account-level share. Direct account shares can distribute portfolio products outside the intended organization boundary.
aws.cb.servicecatalog.no_account_shares.pass_when: PASS when the portfolio has no account-level shares.
aws.cb.servicecatalog.no_account_shares.fail_when: FAIL when the portfolio has any account-level share.

aws.cb.servicecatalog.org_member_no_acco.description: Flags a servicecatalog portfolio when an organization member account portfolio has any account-level share. Direct account shares can distribute portfolio products outside the intended organization boundary.
aws.cb.servicecatalog.org_member_no_acco.pass_when: PASS when that organization member portfolio has no account-level shares.
aws.cb.servicecatalog.org_member_no_acco.fail_when: FAIL when an organization member account portfolio has any account-level share.
aws.cb.servicecatalog.org_member_no_acco.not_applicable_when: When the audited account has no collected AWS Organization membership.

aws.cb.ses.dkim_signing.description: Flags a ses email identity when DKIM signing is disabled or `DkimAttributes.Status` is not SUCCESS. Absent DKIM signing can let forged mail appear to originate from the verified identity.
aws.cb.ses.dkim_signing.pass_when: PASS when signing is enabled and DKIM status is SUCCESS.
aws.cb.ses.dkim_signing.fail_when: FAIL when DKIM signing is disabled or `DkimAttributes.Status` is not SUCCESS.

aws.cb.ses.identity_policies_not_public.description: Flags a ses email identity when an SES identity policy has a public grant and no Deny statement requiring manual review. Absent DKIM signing can let forged mail appear to originate from the verified identity.
aws.cb.ses.identity_policies_not_public.pass_when: PASS when no SES identity policy grants public access.
aws.cb.ses.identity_policies_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when an SES identity policy has a public grant and no Deny statement requiring manual review.
aws.cb.ses.identity_policies_not_public.not_applicable_when: When there are no relevant policy documents on this identity.

aws.cb.sfn.logging_not_off.description: Flags a Step Functions state machine when `loggingConfiguration.level` is exactly `OFF`. State machine executions may run without useful audit records.
aws.cb.sfn.logging_not_off.pass_when: PASS when the logging level is anything other than `OFF`, including a missing configuration.

aws.cb.shield.classic_load_balancer_prot.description: Flags a classic load balancer when the Classic Load Balancer ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory. Without a matching Shield Advanced protection, volumetric DDoS traffic can overwhelm this public endpoint.
aws.cb.shield.classic_load_balancer_prot.pass_when: PASS when the Classic Load Balancer ARN appears in Shield Advanced protections.
aws.cb.shield.classic_load_balancer_prot.fail_when: FAIL when the Classic Load Balancer ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory.
aws.cb.shield.classic_load_balancer_prot.not_applicable_when: When the account has no Shield Advanced subscription.

aws.cb.shield.cloudfront_protected.description: Flags a cloudfront distribution when the CloudFront distribution ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory. Without a matching Shield Advanced protection, volumetric DDoS traffic can overwhelm this public endpoint.
aws.cb.shield.cloudfront_protected.pass_when: PASS when the CloudFront distribution ARN appears in Shield Advanced protections.
aws.cb.shield.cloudfront_protected.fail_when: FAIL when the CloudFront distribution ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory.
aws.cb.shield.cloudfront_protected.not_applicable_when: When the account has no Shield Advanced subscription.

aws.cb.shield.elastic_ip_protected.description: Flags an elastic ip when the Elastic IP allocation ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory. Without a matching Shield Advanced protection, volumetric DDoS traffic can overwhelm this public endpoint.
aws.cb.shield.elastic_ip_protected.pass_when: PASS when the Elastic IP allocation ARN appears in Shield Advanced protections.
aws.cb.shield.elastic_ip_protected.fail_when: FAIL when the Elastic IP allocation ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory.
aws.cb.shield.elastic_ip_protected.not_applicable_when: When the account has no Shield Advanced subscription.

aws.cb.shield.global_accelerator_protect.description: Flags a globalaccelerator accelerator when the Global Accelerator ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory. Without a matching Shield Advanced protection, volumetric DDoS traffic can overwhelm this public endpoint.
aws.cb.shield.global_accelerator_protect.pass_when: PASS when the Global Accelerator ARN appears in Shield Advanced protections.
aws.cb.shield.global_accelerator_protect.fail_when: FAIL when the Global Accelerator ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory.
aws.cb.shield.global_accelerator_protect.not_applicable_when: When the account has no Shield Advanced subscription.

aws.cb.shield.internet_facing_alb_protec.description: Flags a load balancer when the internet-facing Application Load Balancer ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory. Without a matching Shield Advanced protection, volumetric DDoS traffic can overwhelm this public endpoint.
aws.cb.shield.internet_facing_alb_protec.pass_when: PASS when the internet-facing Application Load Balancer ARN appears in Shield Advanced protections.
aws.cb.shield.internet_facing_alb_protec.fail_when: FAIL when the internet-facing Application Load Balancer ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory.
aws.cb.shield.internet_facing_alb_protec.not_applicable_when: When the account has no Shield Advanced subscription or the ALB is internal.

aws.cb.shield.route53_zone_protected.description: Flags a Route 53 hosted zone when the Route 53 hosted zone ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory. Without a matching Shield Advanced protection, volumetric DDoS traffic can overwhelm this public endpoint.
aws.cb.shield.route53_zone_protected.pass_when: PASS when the Route 53 hosted zone ARN appears in Shield Advanced protections.
aws.cb.shield.route53_zone_protected.fail_when: FAIL when the Route 53 hosted zone ARN has no matching Shield Advanced protection in the subscription inventory.
aws.cb.shield.route53_zone_protected.not_applicable_when: When the account has no Shield Advanced subscription.

aws.cb.sns.failure_feedback_role.description: Flags an SNS topic when none of the configured delivery protocol failure-feedback role attributes has an ARN. Failed message deliveries may not be reported to operators.
aws.cb.sns.failure_feedback_role.pass_when: PASS when at least one failure-feedback role ARN is configured.
aws.cb.sns.failure_feedback_role.fail_when: FAIL when none of the configured delivery protocol failure-feedback role attributes has an ARN.

aws.cb.sns.policy_no_public_publish.description: Flags an SNS topic when an unconditioned public principal can invoke `sns:Publish` through the topic policy. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.sns.policy_no_public_publish.pass_when: PASS when no unconditioned public statement grants Publish.
aws.cb.sns.policy_no_public_publish.fail_when: FAIL when an unconditioned public principal can invoke `sns:Publish` through the topic policy.

aws.cb.sns.policy_no_public_subscribe.description: Flags an SNS topic when an unconditioned public principal can invoke `sns:Subscribe` or `sns:Receive` through the topic policy. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.sns.policy_no_public_subscribe.pass_when: PASS when no unconditioned public statement grants Subscribe or Receive.
aws.cb.sns.policy_no_public_subscribe.fail_when: FAIL when an unconditioned public principal can invoke `sns:Subscribe` or `sns:Receive` through the topic policy.

aws.cb.sns.policy_no_unrestricted_wildca.description: Flags an SNS topic when the topic policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.sns.policy_no_unrestricted_wildca.pass_when: PASS when the topic policy has no unrestricted public Allow statement.
aws.cb.sns.policy_no_unrestricted_wildca.fail_when: FAIL when the topic policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement.

aws.cb.sns.policy_prohibit_public_access.description: Flags an SNS topic when the topic policy contains a Turbot-style public Allow statement. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.sns.policy_prohibit_public_access.pass_when: PASS when no topic policy statement matches that public access test.
aws.cb.sns.policy_prohibit_public_access.fail_when: FAIL when the topic policy contains a Turbot-style public Allow statement.
aws.cb.sns.policy_prohibit_public_access.not_applicable_when: When the resource policy is absent.

aws.cb.sns.subscription_not_http.description: Flags a sns subscription when a confirmed SNS subscription uses plaintext `http` protocol. HTTP delivery can expose notification payloads in transit.
aws.cb.sns.subscription_not_http.pass_when: PASS when the confirmed subscription uses another protocol.
aws.cb.sns.subscription_not_http.fail_when: FAIL when a confirmed SNS subscription uses plaintext `http` protocol.
aws.cb.sns.subscription_not_http.not_applicable_when: When the SNS subscription is still PendingConfirmation.

aws.cb.sns.topic_not_publicly_accessible.description: Flags an SNS topic when the Prowler SNS policy test treats a topic policy grant as public. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.sns.topic_not_publicly_accessible.pass_when: PASS when the topic policy has no grant classified as public by that test.
aws.cb.sns.topic_not_publicly_accessible.fail_when: FAIL when the Prowler SNS policy test treats a topic policy grant as public.

aws.cb.sqs.cmk_encryption.description: Flags an SQS queue when the queue has no KmsMasterKeyId or uses the AWS-managed `alias/aws/sqs` key. Queue messages may be lost, disclosed, or accepted from an unintended principal.
aws.cb.sqs.cmk_encryption.pass_when: PASS when a different KMS master key ID is set.
aws.cb.sqs.cmk_encryption.fail_when: FAIL when the queue has no KmsMasterKeyId or uses the AWS-managed `alias/aws/sqs` key.

aws.cb.sqs.dead_letter_queue.description: Flags an SQS queue when the queue has no RedrivePolicy. Queue messages may be lost, disclosed, or accepted from an unintended principal.
aws.cb.sqs.dead_letter_queue.pass_when: PASS when a dead-letter redrive policy is present.
aws.cb.sqs.dead_letter_queue.fail_when: FAIL when the queue has no RedrivePolicy.

aws.cb.sqs.policy_no_wildcard_allow.description: Flags an SQS queue when a queue policy Allow statement has wildcard principal or wildcard action and resource under the evaluator helper. Queue messages may be lost, disclosed, or accepted from an unintended principal.
aws.cb.sqs.policy_no_wildcard_allow.pass_when: PASS when the queue policy has no matching wildcard Allow statement.
aws.cb.sqs.policy_no_wildcard_allow.fail_when: FAIL when a queue policy Allow statement has wildcard principal or wildcard action and resource under the evaluator helper.

aws.cb.sqs.policy_prohibit_public_access.description: Flags an SQS queue when the queue policy contains a Turbot-style public Allow statement. Queue messages may be lost, disclosed, or accepted from an unintended principal.
aws.cb.sqs.policy_prohibit_public_access.pass_when: PASS when no queue statement matches that public access test.
aws.cb.sqs.policy_prohibit_public_access.fail_when: FAIL when the queue policy contains a Turbot-style public Allow statement.
aws.cb.sqs.policy_prohibit_public_access.not_applicable_when: When the resource policy is absent.

aws.cb.sqs.queue_not_public_prowler.description: Flags an SQS queue when the Prowler SQS policy test classifies a queue resource policy as public. Queue messages may be lost, disclosed, or accepted from an unintended principal.
aws.cb.sqs.queue_not_public_prowler.pass_when: PASS when the queue policy is absent or not public under that test.
aws.cb.sqs.queue_not_public_prowler.fail_when: FAIL when the Prowler SQS policy test classifies a queue resource policy as public.

aws.cb.ssm.automation_logs_to_cloudwatch.description: Flags an SSM regional setting when the regional Automation logging setting value is not `CloudWatch`. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.ssm.automation_logs_to_cloudwatch.pass_when: PASS when the setting value is `CloudWatch`.
aws.cb.ssm.automation_logs_to_cloudwatch.fail_when: FAIL when the regional Automation logging setting value is not `CloudWatch`.

aws.cb.ssm.block_public_document_sharing.description: Flags an SSM regional setting when the regional document-sharing setting is not `Disable`. Documents can be shared publicly and expose automation content or credentials embedded in it.
aws.cb.ssm.block_public_document_sharing.pass_when: PASS when the document-sharing setting is `Disable`.
aws.cb.ssm.block_public_document_sharing.fail_when: FAIL when the regional document-sharing setting is not `Disable`.

aws.cb.ssm.document_shared_only_with_tru.description: Flags a ssm document metadata when the document permissions list has account IDs outside the audited account, including `all`. An untrusted account can read or execute shared automation documents.
aws.cb.ssm.document_shared_only_with_tru.pass_when: PASS when every listed account ID is the audited account, or the list is empty.
aws.cb.ssm.document_shared_only_with_tru.fail_when: FAIL when the document permissions list has account IDs outside the audited account, including `all`.

aws.cb.ssm.instance_association_complian.description: Flags an SSM managed instance when a collected Association compliance item has Status other than `COMPLIANT`. Noncompliant associations or missing patches can leave managed instances misconfigured or vulnerable.
aws.cb.ssm.instance_association_complian.pass_when: PASS when all collected Association items have COMPLIANT status.
aws.cb.ssm.instance_association_complian.fail_when: FAIL when a collected Association compliance item has Status other than `COMPLIANT`.
aws.cb.ssm.instance_association_complian.not_applicable_when: When compliance items were not collected or none match the evaluated compliance type.

aws.cb.ssm.instance_patch_compliant.description: Flags an SSM managed instance when a collected Patch compliance item with a nonempty Status is not `COMPLIANT`. Noncompliant associations or missing patches can leave managed instances misconfigured or vulnerable.
aws.cb.ssm.instance_patch_compliant.pass_when: PASS when all Patch items with status are COMPLIANT.
aws.cb.ssm.instance_patch_compliant.fail_when: FAIL when a collected Patch compliance item with a nonempty Status is not `COMPLIANT`.
aws.cb.ssm.instance_patch_compliant.not_applicable_when: When compliance items were not collected or none match the evaluated compliance type.

aws.cb.ssm.resource_compliance_summary_c.description: Flags a ssm resource compliance summary when the resource compliance summary Status differs from `COMPLIANT`. Noncompliant associations or missing patches can leave managed instances misconfigured or vulnerable.
aws.cb.ssm.resource_compliance_summary_c.pass_when: PASS when the summary Status is COMPLIANT.
aws.cb.ssm.resource_compliance_summary_c.fail_when: FAIL when the resource compliance summary Status differs from `COMPLIANT`.

aws.cb.ssmincidents.active_with_response.description: Flags a ssmincidents account when no replication set exists, or its first set is not ACTIVE, or there are no response plans. Without an active response plan, incident responders may not be paged or guided through recovery.
aws.cb.ssmincidents.active_with_response.pass_when: PASS when a replication set is ACTIVE and at least one response plan exists.
aws.cb.ssmincidents.active_with_response.fail_when: FAIL when no replication set exists, or its first set is not ACTIVE, or there are no response plans.

aws.cb.stepfunctions.cmk_encryption.description: Flags a Step Functions state machine when the state machine encryption type is not `CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KMS_KEY`. State machine executions or payloads can lack logging or customer key protection.
aws.cb.stepfunctions.cmk_encryption.pass_when: PASS when the state machine uses customer managed KMS encryption.
aws.cb.stepfunctions.cmk_encryption.fail_when: FAIL when the state machine encryption type is not `CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KMS_KEY`.

aws.cb.stepfunctions.logging_enabled.description: Flags a Step Functions state machine when `loggingConfiguration` is missing or its level is `OFF`. State machine executions or payloads can lack logging or customer key protection.
aws.cb.stepfunctions.logging_enabled.pass_when: PASS when a logging configuration exists with a level other than `OFF`.
aws.cb.stepfunctions.logging_enabled.fail_when: FAIL when `loggingConfiguration` is missing or its level is `OFF`.

aws.cb.storagegateway.fileshare_kms.description: Flags a Storage Gateway file share when the file share `KMSEncrypted` flag is false. Unencrypted file-share data at rest can be disclosed if its backing storage is accessed.
aws.cb.storagegateway.fileshare_kms.pass_when: PASS when file-share KMS encryption is enabled.
aws.cb.storagegateway.fileshare_kms.fail_when: FAIL when the file share `KMSEncrypted` flag is false.

aws.cb.storagegateway.gateway_not_on_ec2.description: Flags a Storage Gateway gateway when the gateway HostEnvironment equals `EC2`. The gateway can inherit EC2 host failure or lose the intended separation of storage access.
aws.cb.storagegateway.gateway_not_on_ec2.pass_when: PASS when the gateway runs in a different host environment.
aws.cb.storagegateway.gateway_not_on_ec2.fail_when: FAIL when the gateway HostEnvironment equals `EC2`.

aws.cb.transfer.connector_logging_role.description: Flags a Transfer Family connector when the connector has no LoggingRole ARN. Connector transfer actions may lack log delivery, hindering investigation of failed or unauthorized transfers.
aws.cb.transfer.connector_logging_role.pass_when: PASS when a connector logging role is configured.
aws.cb.transfer.connector_logging_role.fail_when: FAIL when the connector has no LoggingRole ARN.

aws.cb.transfer.fips_security_policy.description: Flags a Transfer Family server when the server security policy name lacks a `FIPS` hyphen-delimited component. An insecure transfer protocol or cryptographic policy can expose credentials and transferred files.
aws.cb.transfer.fips_security_policy.pass_when: PASS when the security policy name contains a `FIPS` component.
aws.cb.transfer.fips_security_policy.fail_when: FAIL when the server security policy name lacks a `FIPS` hyphen-delimited component.

aws.cb.transfer.no_ftp_protocol.description: Flags a Transfer Family server when `Server.Protocols` contains plaintext `FTP`. An insecure transfer protocol or cryptographic policy can expose credentials and transferred files.
aws.cb.transfer.no_ftp_protocol.pass_when: PASS when the server protocols exclude FTP.

aws.cb.transfer.pqc_ssh_kex_policy.description: Flags a Transfer Family server when the server security policy name is outside the evaluator’s accepted post-quantum SSH policy set. An insecure transfer protocol or cryptographic policy can expose credentials and transferred files.
aws.cb.transfer.pqc_ssh_kex_policy.pass_when: PASS when the policy name belongs to the accepted post-quantum set.
aws.cb.transfer.pqc_ssh_kex_policy.fail_when: FAIL when the server security policy name is outside the evaluator’s accepted post-quantum SSH policy set.

aws.cb.trustedadvisor.check_ok.description: Flags a trustedadvisor check when a Trusted Advisor check result has status other than `ok`. The account can miss a support check result or access to support-backed recommendations.
aws.cb.trustedadvisor.check_ok.pass_when: PASS when the check result status is ok.
aws.cb.trustedadvisor.check_ok.fail_when: FAIL when a Trusted Advisor check result has status other than `ok`.
aws.cb.trustedadvisor.check_ok.not_applicable_when: When Trusted Advisor reports `not_available` for the check.

aws.cb.trustedadvisor.premium_support.description: Flags a Trusted Advisor support record when `PremiumSupport` differs from true. The account can miss a support check result or access to support-backed recommendations.

aws.cb.waf.rule_group_not_empty.description: Flags a classic WAF rule group when the rule group has zero activated rules in a classic WAF resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.waf.rule_group_not_empty.pass_when: PASS when the rule group has an activated rule in a classic WAF resource.
aws.cb.waf.rule_group_not_empty.fail_when: FAIL when the rule group has zero activated rules in a classic WAF resource.

aws.cb.waf.rule_has_conditions.description: Flags a classic WAF rule when the rule has no predicates or match conditions in a classic WAF resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.waf.rule_has_conditions.pass_when: PASS when the rule contains at least one predicate in a classic WAF resource.
aws.cb.waf.rule_has_conditions.fail_when: FAIL when the rule has no predicates or match conditions in a classic WAF resource.

aws.cb.waf.web_acl_has_rules.description: Flags a classic WAF web ACL when the Web ACL has no ordinary rules in a classic WAF resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.waf.web_acl_has_rules.pass_when: PASS when the Web ACL has at least one ordinary rule in a classic WAF resource.
aws.cb.waf.web_acl_has_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL has no ordinary rules in a classic WAF resource.

aws.cb.waf.web_acl_logging.description: Flags a classic WAF web ACL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a classic WAF resource. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.waf.web_acl_logging.pass_when: PASS when a logging destination is configured in a classic WAF resource.
aws.cb.waf.web_acl_logging.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a classic WAF resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.rule_group_not_empty.description: Flags a regional WAF rule group when the rule group has zero activated rules in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_group_not_empty.pass_when: PASS when the rule group has an activated rule in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_group_not_empty.fail_when: FAIL when the rule group has zero activated rules in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.rule_has_conditions.description: Flags a regional WAF rule when the rule has no predicates or match conditions in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_has_conditions.pass_when: PASS when the rule contains at least one predicate in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.rule_has_conditions.fail_when: FAIL when the rule has no predicates or match conditions in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_associated.description: Flags a regional WAF web ACL when the regional Web ACL has no associated resource ARN in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_associated.pass_when: PASS when at least one resource ARN is associated in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_associated.fail_when: FAIL when the regional Web ACL has no associated resource ARN in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_has_rules.description: Flags a regional WAF web ACL when the Web ACL has no ordinary rules in a regional resource. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_has_rules.pass_when: PASS when the Web ACL has at least one ordinary rule in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_has_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL has no ordinary rules in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_logging.description: Flags a regional WAF web ACL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a regional resource. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_logging.pass_when: PASS when a logging destination is configured in a regional resource.
aws.cb.wafregional.web_acl_logging.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a regional resource.

aws.cb.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.description: Flags a WAFv2 rule group when the rule group disables CloudWatch metrics in a WAFv2 resource. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.pass_when: PASS when CloudWatch metrics are enabled for the rule group in a WAFv2 resource.
aws.cb.wafv2.rule_group_metrics.fail_when: FAIL when the rule group disables CloudWatch metrics in a WAFv2 resource.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when the Web ACL has no ordinary `WebACL.Rules`, even if Firewall Manager groups exist. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules.pass_when: PASS when at least one ordinary Web ACL rule exists.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL has no ordinary `WebACL.Rules`, even if Firewall Manager groups exist.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules_or_fms_gr.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when the Web ACL has neither ordinary rules nor pre- or post-process Firewall Manager groups. It reduces request filtering or visibility into attacks against the protected application.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules_or_fms_gr.pass_when: PASS when the Web ACL has an ordinary rule or Firewall Manager group.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_has_rules_or_fms_gr.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL has neither ordinary rules nor pre- or post-process Firewall Manager groups.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_logging.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a WAFv2 resource. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_logging.pass_when: PASS when a logging destination is configured in a WAFv2 resource.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_logging.fail_when: FAIL when the Web ACL logging configuration has no log destination in a WAFv2 resource.

aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.description: Flags a WAFv2 web ACL when any Web ACL rule or Firewall Manager group lacks `VisibilityConfig.CloudWatchMetricsEnabled=true`. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.pass_when: PASS when all evaluated rules and groups enable CloudWatch metrics.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.fail_when: FAIL when any Web ACL rule or Firewall Manager group lacks `VisibilityConfig.CloudWatchMetricsEnabled=true`.
aws.cb.wafv2.web_acl_rule_metrics.not_applicable_when: When the Web ACL has no rules or Firewall Manager groups to inspect.

aws.cb.wellarchitected.no_high_or_medium.description: Flags a wellarchitected workload when RiskCounts contains a positive HIGH or MEDIUM count. High or medium unresolved workload risks can leave known resilience or security weaknesses untreated.
aws.cb.wellarchitected.no_high_or_medium.pass_when: PASS when both HIGH and MEDIUM risk counts are zero or absent.
aws.cb.wellarchitected.no_high_or_medium.fail_when: FAIL when RiskCounts contains a positive HIGH or MEDIUM count.

aws.cb.workspaces.private_subnet_with_na.description: Flags a WorkSpace when the WorkSpace VPC lacks a public subnet, two private subnets, a NAT route, or the WorkSpace subnet is public. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.
aws.cb.workspaces.private_subnet_with_na.pass_when: PASS when the VPC has those subnet and NAT properties and the WorkSpace subnet is private.
aws.cb.workspaces.private_subnet_with_na.fail_when: FAIL when the WorkSpace VPC lacks a public subnet, two private subnets, a NAT route, or the WorkSpace subnet is public.

aws.cb.workspaces.root_and_user_volume_e.description: Flags a WorkSpace when either root or user WorkSpace volume encryption is disabled or omitted. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.
aws.cb.workspaces.root_and_user_volume_e.pass_when: PASS when both WorkSpace volume encryption flags are true.
aws.cb.workspaces.root_and_user_volume_e.fail_when: FAIL when either root or user WorkSpace volume encryption is disabled or omitted.

aws.cb.workspaces.root_volume_encryption.description: Flags a WorkSpace when `RootVolumeEncryptionEnabled` is false. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.

aws.cb.workspaces.user_volume_encryption.description: Flags a WorkSpace when `UserVolumeEncryptionEnabled` is false. Weak subnet layout or volume encryption can expose desktop traffic or persisted user data.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.account_has_log.description: Flags an AWS account when the account has no home-region trail with `Status.IsLogging` true. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.account_has_log.pass_when: PASS when at least one home-region trail is logging.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.account_has_log.fail_when: FAIL when the account has no home-region trail with `Status.IsLogging` true.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.region_has_logg.description: Checks whether a region is covered by a logging local CloudTrail trail or a logging multi-Region trail. No covering trail fails.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.region_has_logg.pass_when: PASS when a local or multi-Region trail covers the region and is logging.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.region_has_logg.fail_when: FAIL when the region has no logging local trail or logging multi-Region trail.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.description: Flags a regional CloudTrail activity window when one identity performs distinct enumeration API actions exceeding the 0.3 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.pass_when: PASS when no identity exceeds that action-diversity fraction for enumeration.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.fail_when: FAIL when one identity performs distinct enumeration API actions exceeding the 0.3 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.description: Flags a regional CloudTrail activity window when one identity performs distinct llm jacking API actions exceeding the 0.4 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.pass_when: PASS when no identity exceeds that action-diversity fraction for llm jacking.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.fail_when: FAIL when one identity performs distinct llm jacking API actions exceeding the 0.4 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.description: Flags a regional CloudTrail activity window when one identity performs distinct privilege escalation API actions exceeding the 0.2 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.pass_when: PASS when no identity exceeds that action-diversity fraction for privilege escalation.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.threat_detectio.fail_when: FAIL when one identity performs distinct privilege escalation API actions exceeding the 0.2 fraction of the configured action set in the collected activity window.

aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.description: Flags a CloudTrail trail when the same-account trail bucket versioning response lacks enabled MFA Delete. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.pass_when: PASS when the trail bucket reports `Versioning.MFADelete=Enabled`.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.fail_when: FAIL when the same-account trail bucket versioning response lacks enabled MFA Delete.
aws.claude2_a.cloudtrail.trail_bucket_mf.not_applicable_when: When the trail is not its home-region copy; cross-account buckets instead require MANUAL review.

aws.claude2_a.cloudwatch.cross_account_s.description: This AWS account evaluator has no FAIL outcome:  a role named CloudWatch-CrossAccountSharingRole triggers MANUAL review of its trusted principals. The result calls for a human decision about cross-account trust rather than asserting a configuration failure.
aws.claude2_a.cloudwatch.cross_account_s.pass_when: PASS when the named sharing role is absent.
aws.claude2_a.cloudwatch.cross_account_s.fail_when: No collected configuration returns FAIL; a cross-account trust concern returns MANUAL.

aws.claude2_a.config.aggregation_authori.description: This config aggregate authorization evaluator has no FAIL outcome:  authorization of another account triggers MANUAL trust review. The result calls for a human decision about cross-account trust rather than asserting a configuration failure.
aws.claude2_a.config.aggregation_authori.pass_when: PASS when the authorized account equals the audited account.
aws.claude2_a.config.aggregation_authori.fail_when: No collected configuration returns FAIL; a cross-account trust concern returns MANUAL.

aws.claude2_a.config.org_aggregator_all_.description: Flags a config aggregator when the Config aggregator is not an organization aggregator, does not cover all regions, or lacks a delegated administrator. An incomplete Config aggregator can omit account or regional configuration changes from central review.
aws.claude2_a.config.org_aggregator_all_.pass_when: PASS when it is an all-region organization aggregator with a Config delegated administrator.
aws.claude2_a.config.org_aggregator_all_.fail_when: FAIL when the Config aggregator is not an organization aggregator, does not cover all regions, or lacks a delegated administrator.

aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.description: This dlm policy evaluator has no FAIL outcome:  a snapshot share to another account triggers MANUAL trust review. The result calls for a human decision about cross-account trust rather than asserting a configuration failure.
aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.pass_when: PASS when no enabled EBS snapshot policy shares to another account.
aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.fail_when: No collected configuration returns FAIL; a cross-account trust concern returns MANUAL.
aws.claude2_a.dlm.snapshot_sharing_trust.not_applicable_when: When the policy is not EBS snapshot management or its state is DISABLED.

aws.claude2_a.logs.log_group_not_public_.description: Flags a log group when a public CloudWatch Logs resource policy names the log group ARN or `*` as a resource. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.claude2_a.logs.log_group_not_public_.pass_when: PASS when no public policy statement covers that log group ARN.
aws.claude2_a.logs.log_group_not_public_.fail_when: FAIL when a public CloudWatch Logs resource policy names the log group ARN or `*` as a resource.

aws.claude2_a.logs.resource_policy_not_p.description: Flags a log resource policy when a CloudWatch Logs resource policy has a Turbot-style public Allow statement. It can permit an outside principal to invoke or read the service resource without the intended trust boundary.
aws.claude2_a.logs.resource_policy_not_p.pass_when: PASS when the resource policy has no such public statement.
aws.claude2_a.logs.resource_policy_not_p.fail_when: FAIL when a CloudWatch Logs resource policy has a Turbot-style public Allow statement.

aws.claude_a.accessanalyzer.active_witho.description: Checks the regional IAM Access Analyzer inventory. The evaluator fails when it is empty, any analyzer is not ACTIVE, or any collected Findings row is present. Standard live collection requests only ACTIVE findings; archived or resolved findings outside that filter are not assessed.
aws.claude_a.accessanalyzer.active_witho.pass_when: PASS when at least one analyzer exists, every analyzer has status ACTIVE, and no collected Findings row is present. Standard live collection does not assess archived or resolved findings.
aws.claude_a.accessanalyzer.active_witho.fail_when: FAIL when no analyzer exists, any analyzer has status other than ACTIVE, or any collected Findings row is present regardless of that row's status. Standard live collection normally supplies only ACTIVE findings.

aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.description: Checks the account's collected CloudTrail inventory for a logging multi-Region trail. It fails when none qualifies, except when an organization trail has unavailable logging status and no other result resolves the check.
aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.pass_when: PASS when at least one multi-Region trail has logging enabled.
aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.fail_when: FAIL when the account has no logging multi-Region trail.
aws.claude_a.cloudtrail.account_has_logg.not_applicable_when: When organization trail status is unavailable and no other logging multi-Region trail resolves the result.

aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.description: Flags an EBS volume when an in-use volume attachment has `DeleteOnTermination` false. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.pass_when: PASS when all in-use attachments have `DeleteOnTermination` true.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.fail_when: FAIL when an in-use volume attachment has `DeleteOnTermination` false.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_delete_on_term.not_applicable_when: When the EBS volume is not in use.

aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.description: Flags an EBS volume when an attached volume has `Encrypted` false. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.pass_when: PASS when each attached volume has encryption enabled.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.fail_when: FAIL when an attached volume has `Encrypted` false.
aws.claude_a.ebs.attached_volume_encrypt.not_applicable_when: When the EBS volume is not in use.

aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_encrypted.description: Flags an EBS snapshot when the EBS snapshot has `Encrypted` false. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_encrypted.pass_when: PASS when the snapshot is encrypted.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_encrypted.fail_when: FAIL when the EBS snapshot has `Encrypted` false.

aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_not_public.description: Flags an EBS snapshot when the EBS snapshot restore permissions include `all`. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_not_public.pass_when: PASS when the restore permissions exclude `all`.
aws.claude_a.ebs.snapshot_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when the EBS snapshot restore permissions include `all`.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_has_snapshot.description: Flags an EBS volume when the complete snapshot inventory has no snapshot with this volume ID. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_has_snapshot.pass_when: PASS when at least one snapshot refers to this volume ID.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_has_snapshot.fail_when: FAIL when the complete snapshot inventory has no snapshot with this volume ID.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_plan_r.description: Flags an EBS volume when no backup selection Resources entry matches the volume ARN or accepted volume wildcard. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_plan_r.pass_when: PASS when a selection Resources entry matches the ARN or accepted wildcard.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_plan_r.fail_when: FAIL when no backup selection Resources entry matches the volume ARN or accepted volume wildcard.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_select.description: Flags an EBS volume when no backup selection matches the volume ARN or a volume tag key. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_select.pass_when: PASS when a backup selection matches the ARN or a volume tag key.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_backup_select.fail_when: FAIL when no backup selection matches the volume ARN or a volume tag key.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_use.description: Flags an EBS volume when the volume state is not `in-use`. An unattached volume may retain sensitive data without a running workload controlling its lifecycle.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_use.pass_when: PASS when the volume state is `in-use`.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_in_use.fail_when: FAIL when the volume state is not `in-use`.

aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_protected_by_bac.description: Flags an EBS volume when the volume ARN is absent from AWS Backup protected resources. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_protected_by_bac.pass_when: PASS when the volume ARN appears among protected resources.
aws.claude_a.ebs.volume_protected_by_bac.fail_when: FAIL when the volume ARN is absent from AWS Backup protected resources.

aws.claude_a.ec2.account_imdsv2_default.pass_when: PASS when the regional default requires IMDSv2.
aws.claude_a.ec2.account_imdsv2_default.fail_when: FAIL when the regional metadata default `HttpTokens` is not `required`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.active_instance_ssm_man.description: Flags an EC2 instance when an eligible active instance ID is missing from the SSM managed-instance inventory. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.

aws.claude_a.ec2.active_instance_ssm_man.fail_when: FAIL when an eligible active instance ID is missing from the SSM managed-instance inventory.
aws.claude_a.ec2.active_instance_ssm_man.not_applicable_when: When the instance state is pending, stopped, or terminated.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_block_public_access.description: Flags an EC2 regional setting when the regional image block-public-access state is `unblocked`. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_block_public_access.fail_when: FAIL when the regional image block-public-access state is `unblocked`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.description: Flags an ec2 image when any AMI block device mapping lacks `Ebs.Encrypted` true. It weakens protection of stored data and may leave key access outside the intended customer control.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.pass_when: PASS when every AMI block device mapping has encrypted EBS.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.fail_when: FAIL when any AMI block device mapping lacks `Ebs.Encrypted` true.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_ebs_encrypted.not_applicable_when: When the AMI has no block device mappings.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_older_than_90_d.fail_when: FAIL when the self-owned AMI creation time precedes the 90-day UTC cutoff.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_public.description: Flags an ec2 image when a self-owned AMI has `Public` true. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ami_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when a self-owned AMI has `Public` true.

aws.claude_a.ec2.client_vpn_connection_l.description: Flags an ec2 client vpn endpoint when client connection logging is disabled on the VPN endpoint. It can leave activity or security events invisible during investigation and delay detection of misuse.

aws.claude_a.ec2.client_vpn_connection_l.fail_when: FAIL when client connection logging is disabled on the VPN endpoint.

aws.claude_a.ec2.ebs_encryption_by_defau.pass_when: PASS when that region has EBS default encryption enabled.
aws.claude_a.ec2.ebs_encryption_by_defau.fail_when: FAIL when a region containing EBS volumes has `EbsEncryptionByDefault` false.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_imdsv2.description: For a Nitro Enclave parent, checks whether MetadataOptions.HttpTokens is required. aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_imdsv2.pass_when: An enclave parent declares MetadataOptions.HttpTokens required.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_imdsv2.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_ingress_al.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a Nitro Enclave parent security group allows world-routable TCP or UDP on ports outside 22, 80, and 443. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_ingress_al.fail_when: FAIL when a Nitro Enclave parent security group allows world-routable TCP or UDP on ports outside 22, 80, and 443.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_ingress_al.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_not_public.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a Nitro Enclave parent has public IPv4, global IPv6 on an attached ENI, or an internet-gateway default route. It can make the service reachable from untrusted networks, increasing the chance of unauthorized access or exploitation.
aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_not_public.pass_when: PASS when none of those public reachability indicators exists.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_not_public.not_applicable_when: When the instance is not a Nitro Enclave parent.

aws.claude_a.ec2.enclave_host_vsock_port.pass_when: PASS when no configured vsock-proxy port is open to globally routable ingress.

aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_in_use.fail_when: FAIL when a network interface is `available` with no attached instance ID.

aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_no_public_ip.pass_when: PASS when the interface has no public IPv4 association.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_no_public_ip.fail_when: FAIL when a network interface has `Association.PublicIp` populated.

aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_source_dest_check.pass_when: PASS when source/destination checking is enabled.
aws.claude_a.ec2.eni_source_dest_check.fail_when: FAIL when a supported network interface type has `SourceDestCheck` false.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ami_not_deprec.fail_when: FAIL when the Amazon-owned AMI referenced by the instance has a past `DeprecationTime`.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_ebs_delete_on_.description: Flags an EC2 instance when any EBS block device mapping has `DeleteOnTermination` false. It increases the chance that data or queued work cannot be recovered after deletion, failure, or corruption.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_imdsv2_applied.description: Flags an EC2 instance when metadata tokens are not `required` or metadata option state is not `applied`. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_imdsv2_or_disa.description: Flags an EC2 instance when a non-terminated instance has metadata enabled without required IMDSv2 tokens. It can expose the instance to unauthorized access, unsafe configuration drift, or loss of operational control.

aws.claude_a.ec2.instance_no_public_ip.pass_when: PASS when the instance has no public IPv4 address.
